metadata.youtube_title: The Real Cost of a $1,000 Black Friday on a Credit Card
metadata.description:
What does a $1,000 Black Friday really cost if it goes on a credit card? At the average 22.36% APR on cards charged interest (Federal Reserve, Q3 2026):

• Pay the full statement balance: $0 interest
• $100 a month: 12 months, $117 interest
• $50 a month: 26 months, $263 interest
• $35 a month: 42 months, $441 interest, $1,441 total

That is 44 cents of interest on every dollar charged.

How the math works: fixed monthly payments, interest charged at APR/12 on the balance each month. Pay-in-full assumes your card has a grace period.

#BlackFriday #CreditCards #PersonalFinance #MoneyTips #Shorts

Sources:
Federal Reserve, G.19 Consumer Credit, released Nov 6, 2026: revolving credit outstanding $1,368.5 billion (Sept 2026, seasonally adjusted, preliminary); commercial bank credit card plan rate, accounts assessed interest, 22.36% (Q3 2026, preliminary). https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g19/current/default.htm

Not financial advice.
